name: In2O3 bixbyite
citation: M. Marezio. Refinement of the crystal structure of In2O3 at two wavelengths. Acta Crystallographica 20 (1966), 723–728.
recommendation: experimental source candidate; native FEFF and numerical validation pending
method: Experimental X-ray crystal-structure refinement at two wavelengths; retain deposited refined coordinates and full occupations.
notes: Both independent In sites are required: multiplicities8 and24, site population weights1/4 and3/4; both have six oxygen neighbors.
The 24d shell splits into2+2+2 neighbors; preserve the splits instead of choosing one representative distance.

COD's _journal_volume field says66, a bibliographic error; the publisher confirms volume20, issue6, pages723–728. Original CIF bytes remain unchanged; citation metadata uses the publisher's correct volume.
No oxygen vacancies or doping are represented; this is the ordered stoichiometric source model.
measurement_conditions_evidence: No measurement temperature or pressure recorded in the downloaded CIF or verified publisher metadata; leave unknown rather than assume ambient.
